_note: Interview fixture answers for lets-craft's ask seam (src/ask.ts, src/fixtures.ts), updated for the pre-craft skill's question-tagging convention (skills/pre-craft/SKILL.md §1.2): every pre-craft question starts with a bracketed English tag ([Feature Name], [Worktree], [Goal], [Constraints], [Success Criteria], [Context]), and every consensus/escalation/handoff gate question ends literally in 'Proceed?'. Anchoring on the tag prefix (rather than a loose keyword like the old 'goal'/'constraint' substrings) avoids the 'approve pattern anchor problem' flagged in the Phase 3.5 handoff -- a loose, unanchored keyword match could accidentally fire on the wrong question or on the tag of a different dimension appearing in prose. Patterns are still necessarily provisional: interview-stage question *bodies* are LLM-generated at runtime and only their tag prefix is contractually fixed, so 'default' remains the fallback for anything these rules don't anticipate (e.g. a mid-round free-form [Goal] follow-up worded differently from the first one). Real usage against the actual pre-craft skill (Phase 7 E2E) may still require refinement.
